english.notes:
(i) This offence wording is for firearms such as section 1 firearms/prohibited weapons only. See also specific offence wordings relating to shotguns, air weapons and imitation firearms at H1163, H1164 and H1215 respectively.(ii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iii) This offence is a specified violent offence under section 306 of the Sentencing Act 2020, see Part 1 of Schedule 18 to that Act; this is, for example, relevant for certain extended sentences of detention or imprisonment.
(iv) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.
